name: route
title_zh: 换模型前先告诉你便宜的那档放弃了什么
tagline_zh: 任务中途想省 token？它先算清降档代价，在切换零成本的节点才放行。写代码、改文案、跑测试。
tagline_en: Mid-task token panic? It calculates what downgrading costs, then switches only at zero-cost points. Per-phase.
desc_en: Pick the model and effort level for the task or phase at hand, say what the cheaper choice gives up, and switch at a point where the switch costs nothing. Use at the start of a task, at each phase change (plan, implement, test, review), when the user asks which model or effort to use, or mentions tokens, quota, usage, cost or context size. Invoke directly with /tokenwise:route <what you're about t
why_zh: 不是一刀切推荐最贵或最便宜，而是按任务阶段动态路由；把「降级损失」摊开讲，让你在知情前提下省钱。
why_en: No blanket 'always pro' or 'always mini'. Routes per phase, surfaces the real trade-off of each downgrade, so you save tokens.
limit_zh: 只在你主动调用或询问时介入，不自动监控全程；需要你描述当前阶段和任务类型，否则只能给通用建议；不替你执行切换。
limit_en: Only acts when invoked or asked; needs you to state phase & task type or it falls back to generic advice. It decides, but you must flip the switch.
title_en: Before you switch models, hear what the cheap one gives up
